message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_16266",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
    "line":1006,"var":"chunk.length","code":"chunk.length = read_u32(data + 8);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"chunk.length is read from the input PNG data; when > SPNG_READ_SIZE (8192) it will trigger realloc in streaming mode"},
   {"step":2,"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
    "line":1049,"var":"data","code":"data = ctx->data;",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Pointer to streaming buffer is saved before read_chunk_bytes; after realloc inside read_data, this pointer becomes stale (dangling) but is never refreshed"},
   {"step":3,"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunk_bytes",
    "line":385,"var":"ctx->data","code":"ret = read_data(ctx, bytes);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"read_chunk_bytes calls read_data which may realloc ctx->data when bytes > data_size in streaming mode"},
   {"step":4,"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_data",
    "line":292,"var":"ctx->data","code":"void *buf = spng__realloc(ctx, ctx->data, bytes);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"realloc frees old ctx->data buffer; the saved 'data' pointer in read_chunks_before_idat now points to freed memory"},
   {"step":5,"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
    "line":1321,"var":"data","code":"char *keyword_nul = memchr(data, '\\0', keyword_len);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Reads from the stale 'data' pointer which points to freed heap memory (use-after-free READ)"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
     "line":1006,"operands":["chunk.length"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
     "line":1049,"operands":["data","ctx->data"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}},
   "sink":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
     "line":1321,"operands":["data","keyword_len"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
       "line":1049,"operands":["data"]},
      "to":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_data",
       "line":292,"operands":["ctx->data"]},
      "type":"data","via":["ctx->data"],
      "relation":{"op":"gt","left":"chunk.length","right":"ctx->data_size"}},
     {"from":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_data",
       "line":292,"operands":["ctx->data"]},
      "to":{"file":"libspng/spng.c","function":"read_chunks_before_idat",
       "line":1321,"operands":["data"]},
      "type":"data","via":["data"],
      "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"data","right":"ctx->data"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
